create_DeepseekVLProcessor: create a DeepseekVLProcessor instance with an image_processor and tokenizer for multimodal text-image input
call_DeepseekVLProcessor: call the DeepseekVLProcessor with text prompts and images to produce input_ids, attention_mask, and pixel_values
batch_decode_DeepseekVLProcessor: batch_decode tokenized outputs from the DeepseekVLProcessor back into readable text strings
decode_DeepseekVLProcessor: decode a single sequence of token ids from the DeepseekVLProcessor into a decoded text string
get_model_input_names: get the combined model_input_names from both the tokenizer and image_processor in the DeepseekVLProcessor
